scripts.prisma:migrate: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); const args=process.argv.slice(1); if(args[0]==='deploy'){console.error('Use pnpm prisma:migrate:deploy or pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --schema ./prisma/schema.prisma.'); process.exit(1)} const cmd=['exec','prisma','migrate','dev','--schema','./prisma/schema.prisma', ...args]; const result=spawnSync('pnpm', cmd, {stdio:'inherit', shell: process.platform==='win32'}); process.exit(result.status ?? 1)"
scripts.build: sh -c 'tmp=$(mktemp); pnpm exec prisma generate --schema ./prisma/schema.prisma >"$tmp" 2>&1 || { cat "$tmp"; rm -f "$tmp"; exit 1; }; rm -f "$tmp"' && sleep 3 && node ../../node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json
